topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I saw it, the intricate design, my creation, now etched permanently on someone’s skin. The realization pooled in my chest, a cold, heavy weight. I always hoped my art would resonate, but this—this was beyond what I imagined. It’s as if a part of me, a脆弱的私人部分, has been taken and placed for all to see. The world is vast and unpredictable, and now, my work is out there, marked on flesh, uncontrolled and exposed. How does one navigate this? What does it mean for the art, for me? The lines, once just ink on paper, now seem so much more, intertwined with someone’s identity.
